svg.title: Trees cut or approved for cutting around Dehradun
svg.desc: Delhi-Dehradun expressway, 16 km near Dehradun: 7,575 trees, felled (NHAI, RTI reply). Bhaniyawala-Rishikesh road (Saat Mod): 4,369 trees, to be cut or moved, 2026. Sahastradhara Road widening: 2,057 trees, proposed; court allowed 1,006. Khalanga forest, water plant: 2,000 trees, about, sal; plan moved after protests.
